title: Vicious
author: V. E. Schwab
summary: Victor and Eli were college friends who became fascinated with how people might gain extraordinary abilities. A decade later they are enemies, one just out of prison and the other determined to stop him.
readIf: you like morally murky superhero stories where nobody is clearly the hero.
skipIf: you want clear heroes and villains or a story with a lot of warmth.

pairings.reason: Another story of brilliant college friends whose obsession leads somewhere very dark.
A lighter story about people with powers and the few who can fight them.
A cast of morally grey characters planning in a tense, well-plotted story.
